messages:
Eva L.: hi folks — first week here, completed basic console access but can't toggle production feature flags or see admin panels. Who should I cc to get prod flag admin? I need to test a rollout for the payments experiment. @sam-onboarding any pointers? :wave:
Sam O.: welcome! :tada: You should file an access ticket with the infra team and add the SSO group name. Quick template:
```text
Title: Request - Console prod FF admin for Eva L.
User: eva@example.com
Env: prod
Role: feature-flag-admin
Reason: needs to run a canary rollout for payments feature
```
Also include the team alias `engineering-payments` and tag @eng-infra.
Jake (infra): I can do a temp lift. Eva — send me your SSO email here or run:
```bash
rbac request --service=console --env=prod --role=feature-flag-admin --user eva@example.com --team engineering-payments
```
I'll grant provisional access for 48h and escalate the permanent group change.
permissions-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-4521 (temp prod FF admin for eva@example.com) — expires in 48h. Requested by Jake.
deploy-bot: Automated note: added `engineering-payments` to console-prod-readonly for eva@example.com while infra review is in progress.
Eva L.: thanks everyone — sending SSO email now. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :pray:
Sam O.: once perm access is in place, add a note to the onboarding checklist so future new-hires know the flow.
Jake (infra): done — provisional role granted. Ping here if anything breaks.
